question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
-- Get the full list of qualified states
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, term_start, state
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE term_number = 0
),
leg_info AS (
    SELECT ft.id_bioguide, ft.term_start, ft.state, l.gender
    FROM first_terms ft
    JOIN legislators l ON ft.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
),
dec31_dates AS (
    SELECT li.id_bioguide, li.state, li.gender, tp.year_offset,
           date_trunc('year', CAST(li.term_start AS DATE)) + INTERVAL (tp.year_offset || ' year') + INTERVAL '364 day' AS dec31
    FROM leg_info li
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT 0 AS year_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
    ) tp
),
retained AS (
    SELECT d.id_bioguide, d.state, d.gender, d.year_offset,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
               WHERE lt.id_bioguide = d.id_bioguide
                 AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= d.dec31
                 AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= d.dec31
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_retained
    FROM dec31_dates d
),
retention_rates AS (
    SELECT state, gender, year_offset, 
           AVG(is_retained::DOUBLE) AS retention_rate
    FROM retained
    GROUP BY state, gender, year_offset
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM retention_rates
    WHERE retention_rate > 0
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gender = 'M' AND retention_rate > 0 THEN year_offset END) = 6
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN gender = 'F' AND retention_rate > 0 THEN year_offset END) = 6
)
SELECT state FROM qualified ORDER BY state
